name: Chthonic-Cwm

civilization.name: Meridian Concord
civilization.notes: Long dead; only ruins and orbital debris remain of a civilization that flourished before the world turned hostile.

description: Silence has shape here: boulder fields, shattered scarps, knife-edge shadows, and far to the west, impact-scarred wastelands. Nothing wears any of it smooth.
Thin air makes every breath a small transaction. Locals, when there are locals, move slowly and speak quietly, conserving everything.
The colonists of the buried megastructure kept meticulous logs right up to the final entry, which is a shopping list. Rescue charters still quote the coordinates, and still decline the contract.
The artifact market prices fragments from this world like scripture. Provenance papers are forged in three systems, badly.
